blocks.content: Quiz: You want to add a "Back to top" button that only appears after the user scrolls down 200 pixels.
Which pattern from this course fits best?
Tap an option below to answer:
Form validation is used for inputs and submit handling, not for reacting to scroll position.

Modals are for overlay dialogs, not scroll-based visibility.
